verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llamafile is a single self-contained executable that runs without installation or setup. That is about avoiding setup, though, not about startup latency. Nothing in the pack documents or measures cold-start time, model load speed, or how quickly inference begins after launch, so the fast-cold-start capability itself is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
